Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with the [Angel]/[Three Great Angels] trait in my security stack, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
Can I use an effect that digivolves my Digimon to digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card with the [Angel]/[Three Great Angels] trait in my security stack?

q: I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into a card with the [Angel]/[Three Great Angels] trait in my security stack, then I placed 1 Digimon card with the [Angel]/[Archangel]/[Three Great Angels] trait from the hand at the bottom of my security stack.
The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but do "when a card is removed from a security stack" or "When a card is added to a security stack" effects trigger?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If it's your turn, search your security stack. This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Three Great Angels] trait among them with the digivolution cost reduced by 2. Then, shuffle your security stack. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from the hand at the bottom of your security stack.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
